options.B: Debit Sales Revenue ₦5,000, Credit Cost of Goods Sold ₦5,000
options.C: Debit Net Income ₦5,000, Credit Cost of Goods Sold ₦5,000
options.D: Debit Cash ₦5,000, Credit Accounts Payable ₦5,000
